clusters.name: harden-tests-and-ledger
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-001 and US-002 add tests to the same model-provider test module and US-003 updates the patch-surface ledger that names those tests; they are small, tightly coupled, and must land together. Run as one serial impl member.

clusters.name: advisory-optional
clusters.executionModeRationale: Behavior change on a disjoint surface (core + tui + snapshot), independent of and deferrable relative to the test cluster. Run only if the lead/operator opts in; otherwise file as a separate follow-up.
